title: 機械設計統合演習
subtitle: Machine Design Project
keywords: Mechanical design, strength and reliability design
educationalGoal: Students will learn about machine design and manufacturing processes and create design plans and drawings that meet the required specifications. In this course, students will learn the design and engineering drawing abilities using 3D-CAD through the practices of modeling mechanical structures assembled with multiple part models.
advice:
The main mechanism studied in this course is a three-axis two-stage helical gear reducer. We will use it to acquire the ability to systematically design machines through comprehensive exercises on modeling and assembly of mechanical element parts.
designing function, performance, accuracy, strength, and reliability of design. utilizing 3D-CAD system for embodiment of machine elements.
Basically, lectures and exercises are held weekly. However, the design and drafting of assigned tasks will not be completed in the practice time during the lecture, so preparation and review as homework will be necessary. In addition, students will use the basics of CAD software that were taught in “Mechanical Elements Design”, “Mechanical Drawing I”, “Mechanical Drawing II” and “Computer Aided Design and Modeling” that they attended before taking this course.
It is assumed that you have mastered the operating and reference methods of the JIS drawing textbook, so please check this material carefully before taking this course.
The topics covered in this course are as follows:
(1) Mechanical design and design process improvement; (2) Mechanical drawing using 3D-CAD and 2D-CAD; (3) 3D-CAD mechanical assembly; (4) Analytical calculation of mechanical design; and (5) Self-inspection and third-party evaluation of mechanical design problems.
A 64-bit version Windows PC is necessary for use of a CAD software.
books:
Textbooks: New JIS mechanical drawing (6th edition) , Morita Kita Publishing (in Japanese)
Mechanical Drawing -operation method using Siemens NX- ,Kanazawa Institute of Technology (in Japanese)
Helical Reducer Design, Power-sha Publishing (in Japanese)
Mechanical Design of Helical Reducer (Exercise), Kanazawa Institute of Technology (in Japanese)
Reference books: None   Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge:
This course is intended as a design and drafting course in the Department of Mechanical Engineering in accordance with the courses of Mechanical Principles/Exercises, Mechanical Drawing I, Mechanical Drawing II, Mechanical Element Design, and Computer Aided Design and Modeling. Therefore, to participate in this course, the design and CAD drawing abilities acquired in these courses are required.
Before attending this course, it is recommended that you review the content acquired in previous courses. Persistent effort is necessary.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the implementation of mechanical design, and use drawings to explain design images.
Be able to carry out design calculations, such as basic design and detailed design of components.
Be able to model a mechanism design and calculate its strength using a computer.
Be able to create machine designs that consider manufacturing methods,  according to the machine drafting rules.
Be able to conceive new design solutions by integrating specialized fields of mechanical engineering.
Be able to learn the latest technology from local engineers, and organize and discuss assignments.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Understand the substance and shape of the design according to the instructions and prepare 3D-CAD and 2D-CAD part models by applying it to your own design conditions. (2) Reflect and feedback the results of structural calculations and analytical approaches for your own design. (3) Perform drafting while fully avoiding shapes that cannot be manufactured or are difficult to form. (4) In designing according to the instructions, it is possible to derive a design solution. (5) Understand the design and problem-solving techniques presented by local engineers.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Understand the content and shape of the design according to the instructions and prepare 3D-CAD and 2D-CAD part models by applying it to your own design conditions. (2) Reflect the results of structural calculations and analytical approaches for your own design. (3) Perform drafting while avoiding shapes that cannot be manufactured or are difficult to form. (4) In designing according to instructions, derive design solutions. (5) Understand the design and problem-solving techniques presented by local engineers.
